scenario: Generate portfolio, resume, or interview material only from State Service-confirmed active Claims and an approved template.

output.semantics: M4 returns a fixed prerequisite refusal and produces no content or artifact.

invocation_condition.full_condition: State Service confirms every referenced Claim is active and final.

dependent_tool_system.m4_boundary: No active-Claims readback exists, so no model, template, or generator call is allowed.

failure_handling.missing_or_inactive_claim: Block the complete request; never fill or infer the gap.
failure_handling.unavailable_authoritative_readback: Refuse before model or tool invocation.
failure_handling.generator_failure: Create no partial artifact or unsupported material.

rules: Request-body Claim IDs are never proof of active status.
Never introduce a new experience, number, result, or causal claim.
Never generate or retain material in M4.
